a' ** (a ** x<[f64]>)

findings: All five use general typed matrix products/transposes, scalar arithmetic and tuples. Their source contains no benchmark-name intrinsic, stored output table or precomputed answer.

The previous C kernel line counts include signatures, declarations, braces and scop pragmas. Line-count ratios reflect syntax/formatting and library abstraction; they do not measure the implementation size of shared operators.
Doitgen flattens the first two tensor axes into matrix rows in the fixed input adapter. This changes representation without precomputing the numeric kernel.

MVT expresses initial_x + ordered_dot. Upstream C initializes its accumulator from initial_x before adding each term. These are algebraically equivalent but have different floating-point association. Current fixed MINI validation is finite with rtol1e-10/atol1e-9, not universal bitwise C equivalence.
